summary: Reconstructed the figure as compilable TikZ (version 2). It has points A, B, C, D, E, F, G with labels; segments BC, CF extended past F to a free end near the top, FB, BE, BA, AF, and AD with G at the intersection of AD and BF. The critic scored version 2 at 0.93 with no remaining issues; labels A–G were confirmed visually.
